title: Feature evidence survey and comparison plan v1

features.description: Consequential named features or claims; empty only when none are supported by the supplied task.

feature_claim.description: Named feature and consequential claim, preserving applicable existing requirements and tolerances.

evidence_ids.description: Existing evidence identifiers only; empty when evidence is unavailable.

observation.description: Facts versus hypotheses; observation type, actual or unknown sensitivity, coverage, correspondence, and configuration. State explicitly if no observation exists.

observable_aspects.description: Aspects supported by the available observation; may be empty.

unobservable_aspects.description: Claim aspects not established by this evidence; may be empty.

exact_artifact_ids.description: Existing exact-artifact identifiers; missing identity belongs in unresolved_inputs.

original_image_frame_ids.description: Existing original image/frame identifiers; empty if unavailable or inapplicable, with explanation in planned_comparison.

camera_crop_distortion.description: Known configuration, proposed treatment, uncertainty, and claim-specific scale/calibration needs; explicitly state inapplicability.

assumptions.description: Explicitly labeled proposed assumptions and their limits, not established facts; may be empty.

fitting_regions.description: Evidence-grounded region descriptions or existing region IDs; no invented masks or coordinates. Empty if none are identified.

held_out_regions.description: Evidence-grounded regions excluded from fitting; empty if none are available.

dependence.description: Shared-source and fitting dependencies; explicitly state absence or uncertainty of independent held-out evidence.

planned_comparison.description: Proposed observable, correspondence, method, scope, limitations, and explanations for consequential empty fields; no execution claim.

sensitivity_plan.description: Null when a bounded sensitivity check is not useful. Otherwise describe a proposal, not a result.

bounds_and_basis.description: Evidence-supported proposed bounds or explicit missing-bound dependency; never invented tolerances.

camera_treatment.description: Fixed camera treatment or explicit uncertainty quantification; unresolved uncertainty must be identified.

method_and_limits.description: Bounded proposed check, expected observable, what it can establish, and residual limitations.

unresolved_inputs.description: Each entry names the missing dependency, affected claim, why it matters, and a targeted resolving input or research action. Empty when none are identified.

plan_status.description: Planning readiness only: planned means a comparison is specified; partial means useful planning remains possible despite gaps; awaiting_input means this feature's comparison depends on missing input. No validation or approval meaning.
